Where the figure comes from
slides.body: A commentary in Addis Standard cites a September assessment by the Tigray Disaster Risk Management Commission. Not independently verified.

slides.title: Displaced families in Mekelle
slides.body: One woman displaced from Humera told the author food rations were often late and the last distribution at her centre was in June. Single account.

slides.title: Health and access
slides.body: The ICRC says it delivered medical supplies across Tigray, but insecurity threatens civilians' access to treatment, food and clean water.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Keep aid access open.
